current.text: He is the third-string center in Chicago, behind Nick Claxton and Jalen Smith.
He competes with Patrick Williams and Leonard Miller for the 10th rotation spot.
Chicago re-signed him at a high salary.
The expert thinks he was re-signed mainly as a trade piece. This fits a front office that signs veterans in the hope of trading them.
A toe injury kept him out of most of last season.
Yahoo lists him as questionable with a toe injury.

durable.text: He gets very few steals, a clear weak spot even against the whole top 250 pool.

note: Do not draft him. Yahoo ranks him 240 and ESPN ranks him 304, both value him at 0 USD, and our league drafts only 144 players. He is a third-string center who may not make the rotation, he is listed questionable with a toe problem, and his small projected line (about 7 points and 4.5 rebounds) has no standout category. Ignore him on waivers unless injuries to Nick Claxton and Jalen Smith give him real minutes.
